About Us

Tirunelveli’s celebration team.

Our Story

King Events began with a simple idea: every family in Tirunelveli deserves a celebration that looks royal without the stress. From our base in Kalanthapanai, we bring decoration, catering and entertainment together under one team.

We treat every wedding as our own family function — fresh marigolds, jasmine thoranams, brass lamps and a team that arrives early and stays until the last guest leaves.
